payload.title: [gateway] Object Delta fan-out drops rows for object types without an `id` field
payload.description: Found by the FR-250 conformance suite. pack_object_record errored on the injected `id` key for schema object types that declare no id field (e.g. productTestSchema User), so the object Delta was silently dropped — a real wire divergence from the TS server. Fixed by stripping the record id before packing (it rides the packed tuple's id slot), matching TS withoutRecordId, in both fan_out_object_upsert and pack_object_rows. Guarded by a conformance scenario (HTTP upsert -> live object Delta). Commit efc1840.
